warning_texts: release/report.md line 24 prints a monthly revenue trend and a strongest month with no claim behind them; the direction matches raw net amounts today, but nothing in the pipeline would catch it once it stops being true.

No deterministic rule in audit/check_plan.json inspects release prose for unregistered assertions: release_surface_gate only sees numbers, and claims_rendered/caveats_rendered only confirm that registered claims and caveats are present, so a digit-free analytical sentence passes every machine gate.

gate_release_document's claims_rendered and caveats_rendered are both listed under accepted_unproven in audit/check_plan.json because prove_plan failed to run them (FileNotFoundError), so those two rules were never shown to fire on a broken release.
